source.topic: Mike Tyson, boxing history, discipline and movement
source.source_text: Mike Tyson became known for an aggressive heavyweight style built around speed and pressure. Trainer Cus D’Amato was Tyson’s coach and legal guardian. Muhammad Ali, Sugar Ray Robinson, and Joe Frazier are major figures in boxing history; this narration does not suggest they fought or coached Tyson. A short visual story can show focused preparation, movement in the ring, and a measured close. Discipline gives power a direction. Speed changes the distance. Pressure shapes the rhythm. Footwork creates the opening. Technique makes aggression precise. These are editorial narrator lines, not quotations.
